claims.claim: Canonical REPAIR authoring reconstruction injects all bounded H2 strategy facts before Stage 1, uses an isolated observation repository, and binds transported inputs through snapshot comparison and the existing audited-authoring freshness boundary.

The projection distinguishes reusable PRESENT/ABSENT/INVALID and structural PRESENT/MISSING/INVALID states, validates package identities and committed deltas, rejects duplicate keys, and reports acceptance coverage separately.

All four action eligibility entries use shared Runtime structural and reuse predicates. The projection contains no strategy preference or mutation-required judgment and grants no execution authority; authorization, scope, Executor, and reuse admission gates remain explicit.

Authoring, remediation admission, root derivation, and publication consumers validate successful REPAIR provenance against canonical wrapper, candidate, review, authorization, failed-head, root, result-base, and prior-review bindings. Valid REPAIR provenance retains its identity through DELTA remediation; invalid or missing correction lineage is rejected.

Focused regressions were added for projection states, shared reuse policy, read-only reconstruction, authoring drift, successful REPAIR-to-remediation continuity, and adversarial lineage substitutions.
